breaking_news.headline: This factory was severely short on workers. Then it offered flexible work
breaking_news.summary: A GE Appliances plant in rural northwest Georgia was short hundreds of workers amid COVID-19. A flexible work option where some workers can sign up for shifts through an app has eased the pain.

breaking_news.headline: Tensions with Iran add fresh uncertainty to an already shaky global economy
breaking_news.summary: Crude oil prices jumped and stock prices fell after President Trump declared an end to the ceasefire with Iran, adding fresh uncertainty to an already shaky outlook for the global economy.

breaking_news.headline: Should you sign your kids up for Trump Accounts? Four things to consider
breaking_news.summary: Families can still benefit even if their children aren't eligible for the free $1,000 contribution from the federal government.

breaking_news.headline: New aviation mechanics graduate with jobs in hand, thanks to a labor shortage
breaking_news.summary: Aviation is literally soaring in the U.S., with record passenger numbers. But with a generation of mechanics set to leave the workforce, the industry needs new graduates to fill the gap.

breaking_news.headline: EPA proposes weakening heavy-duty truck pollution rules
breaking_news.summary: The Trump EPA calls Biden-era rules for cutting pollution from heavy trucks "unworkable." The proposed changes have been celebrated by trucking groups and denounced by environmental groups.

breaking_news.headline: Gas prices are swinging. How to budget for volatility
breaking_news.summary: Gas prices have fluctuated since the U.S. and Israel launched a war on Iran, which disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and left consumers unsure of what they'll pay at the pump.

breaking_news.headline: Microsoft is doing a hard reset of its Xbox gaming division
breaking_news.summary: This week, Microsoft announced they were laying off over 3,000 staff at Xbox. What will the impact be on the company? And what do these layoffs say about the gaming industry right now?

breaking_news.headline: A major housing bill is set to become law at midnight — even though Trump says he won't sign
breaking_news.summary: President Trump says he is refusing to sign the bill without Congress first passing his sweeping voter ID bill.

breaking_news.headline: China lands reusable rocket for first time, state media says
breaking_news.summary: It follows similar landings of reusable rockets by US-owned companies SpaceX and Blue Origin.

breaking_news.headline: Boxy forms and odd lights: US declassifies more UFO files
breaking_news.summary: The US government published a fourth instalment of unresolved cases, promising to release more files on a rolling basis.

breaking_news.headline: New dinosaur species with neck as long as cricket pitch discovered in Thailand
breaking_news.summary: The plant-eating dinosaur, named Uragasaurus kalasinensis, is thought to have lived about 150 million years ago.

breaking_news.headline: Man fatally shot by ICE in Houston was not intended target, DHS says
breaking_news.summary: Immigration agents were looking for a different person when they shot Lorenzo Salgado Araujo during a traffic stop, officials say.

breaking_news.headline: Zulu king expresses regret after video captures tirade against his wife
breaking_news.summary: In the footage widely shared in South Africa, King Misuzulu threatens to physically assault his wife and accuses her of cheating.

breaking_news.headline: East Asia braces for destructive typhoon as landslides kill 15 in Philippines
breaking_news.summary: Heading for Taiwan and south-eastern China, the 1,000 km-wide Bavi is forecast to be one of the strongest storms in decades.

breaking_news.headline: Wildfire in southern Spain leaves at least 12 dead and 23 missing
breaking_news.summary: A local official said four of the victims may be British after a fire broke out near Los Gallardos, Almería.

breaking_news.headline: Chip giant SK Hynix raises $26.5bn as shares surge in bumper US listing
breaking_news.summary: The shares surged as much as 17% in their Nasdaq trading debut on Friday following the record-breaking foreign listing.

breaking_news.headline: We've saved £6,000 on holidays by swapping homes with strangers
breaking_news.summary: The BBC looks at the growing trend of people swapping homes to cut holiday costs.

breaking_news.headline: Pressure builds on Europe's biggest port to be greener
breaking_news.summary: A lawsuit demands that the Port of Rotterdam moves faster to cut its dependence on fossil fuel firms.

breaking_news.headline: Vapes to have less enticing names and flavours to protect children
breaking_news.summary: People are being consulted about plans to stop vape companies using enticing flavour descriptions that "attract" children into experimenting.

breaking_news.headline: Man nearly sucked out of window mid-air on Ryanair plane, passengers say
breaking_news.summary: The man's wife held onto his legs for around five minutes to stop him from being sucked out, officials say.
